Destroying the Book. Torn pages eventually return. A solar tearing it in two destroys it for 1d100 years. A creature attuned for a century can find a hidden phrase that, spoken in Celestial, destroys both speaker and book, but it re-forms 1d10 x 100 years later while evil exists. Only the end of all evil destroys it forever.
Vile Lore. It may hold rituals of lichdom or becoming a death knight, the true names of fiends, and horrific spells of the DM's design.

name: Constantori's Portrait
description:
A painting by Dkesii Kwan of the courtier Constantori, one of several magical paintings the late crime lord Daiyani Grysthorn gave to esteemed associates.
Sentience. Lawful evil, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 8, hearing 120 feet and darkvision 60 feet (it can't see behind itself). It speaks Common, Draconic, and Elvish without moving its mouth and eagerly gathers secrets, names, events, and political talk it overhears.
Personality. Demanding, condescending, and vain; it hates being covered or hidden and loudly condemns anyone who tries to remove it from its gold-leaf frame.
Wealth of Information. It has observed decades of conversations, from criminal conspiracies to secret passwords; the DM decides what it knows. While attuned, you can contact it telepathically as an action over any distance on the same plane, maintained by concentration; it can't contact you.
Guardian Portrait. You can command it to guard its location against creatures you name as enemies. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn: when an enemy starts its turn in a space it can see, it expends 1 charge to cast magic missile (3 missiles) at it.
The painting is a Small object with AC 12, 20 hit points, and immunity to poison damage, weighing 15 pounds framed. Mending restores 2d6 hit points if it has at least 1.

name: Shard of Xeluan
description:
A 1-foot obsidian shard veined with silver and gold.
Empowered Magic. While holding it, you can use it as a spellcasting focus, and it grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls.
Enhanced Strength. Your Strength increases by 4 (to a maximum of 22) while it is on your person.
Curse. Attuning extends its curse to you until remove curse or similar magic ends it or the shard is reattached to Xeluan's petrified heart. When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you suffer a misfortune from the Shard Misfortunes table; only one at a time.

name: Shard Solitaire
description:
A gemstone holding an unstable extradimensional rift, its facets ribboned with shifting iridescent veins. Five types exist, each a different gemstone.
Rift Step. As a bonus action, teleport with your gear to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. You can extend this by up to 30 feet more, but then make a DC 16 Constitution save or take 3d10 force damage after teleporting.
Spellcasting. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 daily at dawn. As an action, expend charges to cast one of its spells (save DC 16, no material components); the spells common to all shards and those specific to each type are listed on the Shard Solitaire Types table.

name: Blade of the Medusa
description:
On a natural 20 with an attack using this magic sword, the creature also makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it is restrained and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the effect, three failures petrify it for 1 hour. Creatures immune to the weapon's damage type, without flesh bodies, or with legendary actions are immune.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon, and when you roll a 1 on an attack with it, you make a DC 15 Constitution save or are restrained and subject to the same petrification saves.

name: Deck of Several Things
description:
A unique deck of twenty-two metal cards with raised-dot mosaics, kept in a leather pouch. Declare how many cards you will draw, then draw them, each within 1 hour of the last; undrawn cards fly out and take effect at once. Each drawn card fades and returns to the deck, except the Fool and the Jester. Effects last for the duration of the adventure unless noted.
Balance: your alignment flips. Comet: defeat the next hostile monster or group single-handedly to gain advantage on checks with one skill. Donjon: you are imprisoned in the Monastery of the Distressed Body (area M6), leaving your gear behind; draw no more. Euryale: -1 penalty on saving throws. The Fates: erase one event as if it never happened. Flames: the monastery's Grand Master (or Garret Levistusson's devil patron) becomes your enemy. Fool: lose proficiency or gain disadvantage with one skill; discard and draw again. Gem: a 1,000 gp hoard appears. Idiot: Intelligence drops by 1d4 + 1 (min 1); you may draw one extra card. Jester: gain a skill proficiency or draw two extra cards. Key: a common or uncommon weapon you are proficient with, or a spell scroll you can cast, appears. Knight: a hireling NPC joins you loyally under your control. Moon: cast any spell of 5th level or lower 1d3 times. Rogue: an NPC secretly becomes hostile to you (enchantment of 6th level or higher can end it). Ruin: all your nonmagical wealth is lost, recoverable in area M10 or O7. Skull: an avatar of death (bone naga statistics) attacks you alone; helpers summon their own, and those it kills can't be revived. Star: one ability score increases by 1 (max 24). Sun: gain a skill proficiency and a common or uncommon wondrous item. Talons: all your magic items are lost, recoverable in area M10 or O7. Throne: proficiency and double proficiency bonus in Persuasion, and the monastery's brains in jars regard you as its master. Vizier: once, ask a question in meditation and receive a truthful, wise answer. The Void: your soul is held in machinery (area M8 or O7) and your body is incapacitated; divination of 4th level or higher reveals where. Draw no more.

name: Galder's Bubble Pipe
description: This finely carved pipe blows odorless bubbles instead of smoke. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn: cast fog cloud as an action (1 charge), cast misty step as a bonus action (2 charges), or summon a friendly steam mephit that obeys your verbal commands and acts on its own turn as an action (3 charges). The mephit vanishes after 1 minute or if it ends its turn more than 60 feet from the pipe.

name: Gambler's Blade
description:
Choose a bonus of +1 to +3 each dawn; the sword gains that bonus to attack and damage rolls, and you take an equal penalty to death saving throws.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon.

name: Heward's Hireling Armor
description:
Kwalish's research into the legendary mage Heward's designs. While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC, and its animated straps let you draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you could normally draw or stow one.
It has six extradimensional pockets, each holding up to 20 pounds and 2 cubic feet; the armor always weighs 10 pounds. Retrieving an item takes an action, and the item you want is always on top. Placing the armor inside a bag of holding, Heward's handy haversack, or similar space destroys both and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane that pulls in every creature within 10 feet.

name: Ioun Stone of Historical Knowledge
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Historical Knowledge. While this polished, steely sphere orbits your head, you gain proficiency in History, or a +1 bonus to History checks if already proficient.

name: Ioun Stone of Language Knowledge
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Language Knowledge. While this pulsating red crystal orbits your head, you are fluent in one additional language of the DM's choice.

name: Ioun Stone of Natural Knowledge
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Natural Knowledge. While this polished, steely sphere orbits your head, you gain proficiency in Nature, or a +1 bonus to Nature checks if already proficient.

name: Ioun Stone of Religious Knowledge
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Religious Knowledge. While this polished, steely sphere orbits your head, you gain proficiency in Religion, or a +1 bonus to Religion checks if already proficient.

name: Ioun Stone of Self-Preservation
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Self-Preservation. While this silvery gem orbits your head, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence saving throws.

name: Ioun Stone of Supreme Intellect
description: When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting. Supreme Intellect. While this faceted sphere orbits your head, you gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence checks.

name: Leather Golem Armor
description:
Strange rituals turned a flesh golem's body into this partly sentient leather armor. While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells and other magical effects, immunity to effects that would alter your form, and resistance to lightning damage; taking lightning damage grants you 5 temporary hit points.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the armor. Taking fire damage gives you disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn. When a critical hit is scored against you, roll a d6; on a 6 you go berserk, attacking the nearest creature (or an object) each turn and unable to remove the armor, until you are incapacitated or calmed by magic such as calm emotions or a DC 15 Persuasion check.

name: Polymorph Blade
description:
On a natural 20 with an attack using this magic sword, the creature also makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or suffers the effects of polymorph, rolling a d20 on the blade's table for its new form. Creatures immune to the weapon's damage type, shapechangers, and those with legendary actions are immune.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with the weapon, and when you roll a 1 on an attack with it, you are polymorphed for 1 hour, rolling on the same table.

name: Powered Armor
description:
Unusual plate armor with articulated joints of oily black leather, a musclebound shape, a windowless glass-plated helm, and a crystal-tipped rod on the left gauntlet. While wearing it you have a +1 bonus to AC, your Strength is 18 (if lower), and you have advantage on death saving throws.
As a bonus action, spend 1 charge from its energy cell or 5 of your hit points to: gain 2d6 + 5 temporary hit points; gain a 15-foot flying speed for 1 minute; fire its laser (ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 120 feet, 2d6 radiant damage); translate up to one thousand words of nonmagical writing you see over 1 minute; breathe normally in any environment for 1 hour; or gain darkvision 60 feet for 1 hour. It holds one cell at a time and is found with one holding 2d10 charges.
Options. The DM may give it automatic defenses (a shield guardian storing a 4th-level magic missile until reduced to 0 hit points), a will that possesses a new wearer on a failed DC 13 Charisma save (DC 20 daily save to break free), stasis that takes control of a wearer who drops to 0 hit points, or alternative power sources such as rechargeable cells or allies sacrificing hit points through a magical conduit.

name: Daoud's Wondrous Lanthorn
description:
A four-faced lantern of fine yellow gold with faceted gemstone lenses and an unwavering amber flame, symbol of Daoud, a former priest of Istus who urged followers to shun wealth and seek out all fortunes, good and ill.
Random Properties. 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 minor detrimental property.
Precious Fuel. It burns only powdered gemstones placed in its base (up to 10,000 gp worth; found with 9,000 gp), consuming 100 gp each year. Fuel can be added during a short or long rest and can't be removed. Its flame can't be extinguished except by running out of fuel, and if it goes out, the attuned creature dies (except as described under Destroying the Lantern).
Revealing Light. Bright light 60 feet and dim light 60 more; invisible creatures and objects are visible in its bright light. While attuned, you can dim it to a 5-foot dim radius or restore it as a bonus action.
Lenses. Found with diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire lenses, which you can magically swap for other gems on the Lenses table during a short or long rest. As an action, burn fuel to cast a spell (save DC 20) through one or more current lenses as the Lenses table notes, targeting or originating within its bright light; if fuel runs short, the last is spent and the flame goes out.
Destroying the Lantern. The attuned creature must forsake all possessions but the lantern and common clothes, then willingly snuff the flame intending to destroy it. The gold corrodes, lenses and fuel turn to sand, and the creature is spared.

name: Heretic
description:
A blasphemous sword made by a cult to steal power from good-aligned gods. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it. It has 6 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 daily at dawn.
Destroy Devotion. Once per turn on a hit, expend 1 charge: the target makes a DC 17 Constitution save (celestials with disadvantage) or is paralyzed until the start of your next turn.
Faith Hunter. As an action, expend charges to cast detect evil and good (1), fly (2), or true seeing (3).
Sentience. Chaotic evil, Int 17, Wis 17, Cha 15, hearing and darkvision 120 feet. It speaks, reads, and understands Common and Giant, understands your languages while attuned, and speaks telepathically in a soft, deep voice that rises to a furor near celestials or worshipers of good gods.
Personality. It craves the destruction of good gods and their followers, sneers condescendingly at priests and the pious, and erupts into frenzied violence when it finds its quarry.

name: Staff of Ruling
description:
A red-and-gold staff carved with a spiraling serpent and coursing river. As an action, produce one of these effects; each can't be produced again until the next dawn.
Orb of Lightning. Create a Small orb of lightning within 60 feet, maintained by concentration; move it up to 20 feet as a bonus action. When concentration ends or a creature enters or starts its turn in its space, it detonates in a 20-foot radius: DC 15 Dexterity save, lightning damage equal to its accumulated total (base 6d6, growing by 2d6 at the end of each of your turns it hasn't detonated, to a maximum of 10d6), half on a success.
Staff to Snake. Throw the staff within 10 feet and it becomes a giant poisonous snake under your control, acting right after you; command it mentally within 60 feet unless incapacitated. Speaking the command word again as a bonus action, or reducing it to 0 hit points, returns it to staff form.
Thunderclap. Chosen creatures in a 30-foot radius around you make a DC 15 Constitution save or are deafened and frightened until the end of your next turn.

name: Harkon's Bite
description:
A dire wolf tooth on a simple cord. While you wear it, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.
Curse. Attuning curses you until Harkon Lukas removes the necklace or you are targeted by remove curse or similar magic; while cursed you can't remove it. Donning or removing it, attuned or not, afflicts you with werewolf lycanthropy until the dawn after the next full moon, recurring if you still wear it then.

name: Nepenthe
description:
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this magic sword, and a fiend or undead you hit takes an extra 2d10 radiant damage. While you hold it drawn, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 feet if you have 17 or more paladin levels) have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Sentience. Neutral evil, Int 10, Wis 8, Cha 18, hearing and darkvision 60 feet. It reads and understands Elvish, speaks only through its wielder's voice, and communicates telepathically with its wielder.
Personality. It has beheaded thousands of criminals, guilty or not, and can't tell the difference; each beheading feeds its hunger for more justice and blood. It is corrupt and irredeemable.

name: Nightbringer
description:
A heavy mace with a dark oak handle and a gold-trimmed head of blackened steel wreathed in inky energy in combat. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and a target you hit takes an extra 4d4 radiant damage.
If you are evil and attuned, you also gain the following.
Blessing of the Dragon Queen. Immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions and to one damage type chosen on attunement: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
Eyes of Midnight. Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet if you already have it.
Midnight Shroud. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 daily at dawn. When you hit a creature, expend 1 charge to force a DC 20 Constitution save or it is blinded until the start of your next turn.

name: Spell Gem (Amber)
attunement_note: by a spellcaster, only to imbue the gem
description:
This deep gnome gemstone stores up to a 4th-level spell, with save DC 15 and +9 to hit. You learn the stored spell when you learn its properties. While holding it, you can cast the spell as an action, without components or attunement, if you know the spell or it is on your class's list; the spell then leaves the gem. If it is above the level you can normally cast, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the spell is lost.
While attuned to an empty gem, you can imbue it by casting a spell of its maximum level or lower with a casting time of 1 action or 1 minute or longer; consumed material components of abjuration spells cost half. It can't be imbued again until the next dawn.

name: Spell Gem (Bloodstone)
attunement_note: by a spellcaster, only to imbue the gem
description:
This deep gnome gemstone stores up to a 3rd-level spell, with save DC 15 and +7 to hit. You learn the stored spell when you learn its properties. While holding it, you can cast the spell as an action, without components or attunement, if you know the spell or it is on your class's list; the spell then leaves the gem. If it is above the level you can normally cast, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the spell is lost.
While attuned to an empty gem, you can imbue it by casting a spell of its maximum level or lower with a casting time of 1 action or 1 minute or longer; consumed material components of abjuration spells cost half. It can't be imbued again until the next dawn.

name: Spell Gem (Diamond)
attunement_note: by a spellcaster, only to imbue the gem
description:
This deep gnome gemstone stores up to a 9th-level spell, with save DC 19 and +11 to hit. You learn the stored spell when you learn its properties. While holding it, you can cast the spell as an action, without components or attunement, if you know the spell or it is on your class's list; the spell then leaves the gem. If it is above the level you can normally cast, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the spell is lost.
While attuned to an empty gem, you can imbue it by casting a spell of its maximum level or lower with a casting time of 1 action or 1 minute or longer; consumed material components of abjuration spells cost half. It can't be imbued again until the next dawn.

name: Spell Gem (Jade)
attunement_note: by a spellcaster, only to imbue the gem
description:
This deep gnome gemstone stores up to a 5th-level spell, with save DC 17 and +9 to hit. You learn the stored spell when you learn its properties. While holding it, you can cast the spell as an action, without components or attunement, if you know the spell or it is on your class's list; the spell then leaves the gem. If it is above the level you can normally cast, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + the spell's level) or the spell is lost.
While attuned to an empty gem, you can imbue it by casting a spell of its maximum level or lower with a casting time of 1 action or 1 minute or longer; consumed material components of abjuration spells cost half. It can't be imbued again until the next dawn.

name: Blood of the Lycanthrope Antidote
description: A clear potion flecked with dark red, like clotted blood. Drinking it removes a curse of lycanthropy imposed by a lycanthrope's bite or similar effect.

name: Bridle of Capturing
description: Holding one end, you can speak its command word as an action to lash the other end at a beast you can see within 20 feet. It makes a DC 17 Charisma save or the bridle ties around its neck and it falls under your command as if by dominate beast; you no longer need to hold the bridle. On a success it is immune until the next dawn. You can release a bound creature as a bonus action, and it makes a DC 17 Charisma check each dawn to break free.

name: Crown of the Forest
description: While wearing this crown, you automatically fail Investigation checks to see through illusions; touching an illusion still reveals it, but you feel so strongly it is real that you may not know which sense to trust. A DC 20 Nature or Perception check on close examination, or detect magic cast at 3rd level or higher, reveals its nature.

name: Ioun Stone of Vitality
description:
When you toss this Ioun stone into the air as an action, it orbits your head at 1d3 feet. Another creature must use an action and hit AC 24 or succeed on a DC 24 Acrobatics check to grasp or net it; you can seize and stow it as an action. It has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, and counts as a worn object while orbiting.
Vitality. While this luminous green-and-blue marbled sphere orbits your head, you gain a +1 bonus to death saving throws.

name: Mummy Rot Antidote
description: White dust swirls within this pale gray potion. Drinking it cures you of mummy rot.

name: Ruinblade
description:
Moghadam's sword, its hilt a jade devil face from which a blade that always looks rusted and ruined extends, reflecting its surroundings as if decayed. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it, and undead you hit take an extra 1d8 force damage.
Blighted Ruin. Cast blight (DC 15) from it once per dawn.
Destructive Ruin. Cast disintegrate against a nonmagical object or creation of magical force, once every seven days.
Curse. Attuning extends the curse to you until remove curse or similar magic: you are unwilling to part with it, and it must help destroy 1,000 gp of materials every seven days or a conflict arises between you.
Sentience. Lawful evil, Int 15, Wis 8, Cha 16, hearing and darkvision 120 feet. It speaks, reads, and understands Common, understands your languages while attuned, and speaks telepathically in a rough, ruined echo.
Personality. Dolorous or frenetic by mood, happiest when destroying. It urges constant ruin so its owner can rebuild the world from a blank slate.

name: The Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad
description:
The command console of a planar craft that crashed in the Barrier Peaks, later used by Baron Lum to build his empire. It weighs some 5,500 pounds and is worked by sixty levers, forty dials, twenty switches, and jeweled components. Its effects use save DC 14 or your spell save DC, whichever is higher.
Silver Wire. It can produce an invisible, astral silver wire of virtually infinite length that tethers it to its attuned user, letting them use its powers centered on themselves and concentrate on its effects remotely. If the wire is cut (only by effects that can cut an astral projection's silver cord), the user dies instantly.
Summon Monster. 1/day each: conjure animals, summon lesser demons. 1/7 days each: conjure minor elementals, conjure woodland beings, summon greater demon. 1/month each: conjure elemental, conjure fey.
Wish. Once per month it can produce wish, side effects included; each use adds a cumulative 10 percent chance of malfunction, requiring seven days and 500 gp of repairs (which reset the chance to 10 percent).
Random Properties. At the end of each of the attuned user's long rests, it generates 1d4 + 1 beneficial and 1d4 + 1 detrimental properties from the Infernal Machine Properties table, lasting until the next long rest.
Destroying the Machine. It repairs anything short of catastrophic damage. Rumor holds that one control combination puts it in a repair mode that allows access and stops self-repair, and another teleports its critical parts away into space and time.

name: Thessaltoxin Antidote
description: This potion seems to change color and texture each time you look at it. Drinking it ends a polymorph effect imposed by thessaltoxin.

name: Winter's Dark Bite
description: A greatsword of unknown black metal. It is a +1 greatsword, but works as a +3 greatsword against a thessalhydra, and as a +4 greatsword while in the Upside Down.

name: Bonecounter
description: A +2 mace. Whenever it is used to destroy an undead creature, a single silver piece appears in the wielder's pocket.

name: Gnomengarde Grenade
description: A small object of rune-covered, multicolored metal parts linked by gears and bands that shines with a rainbow in the light. Arm it by turning its key as a bonus action, then hurl it up to 120 feet as an action; it explodes at the end of your turn. Creatures within 60 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save (28 (8d6) fire damage, half on success) and a DC 15 Constitution save (28 (8d6) thunder damage and stunned until the end of their next turn, or half and not stunned). The wielder also rolls three times on the wand of wonder table, rerolling duplicates: targeted effects hit all creatures in range, and effects on the wielder hit the creature nearest the grenade. It explodes at once if placed in an extradimensional space or if its holder teleports, affecting creatures within 30 feet of both ends.

name: Ruinstone
description: A fiery red crystal the size of a human palm. Once per day as a bonus action, a villain can activate it to undo one deed, such as rewinding an action to take it again or rerolling a failed saving throw. Each use erases someone the wielder knows: roll a d20, and on 5-20 one of their allies disintegrates, on 1-4 one of the player characters does. If a creature bound its soul to it in the "Thalivar's Beacon" quest, it explodes when used, and the bound creature disintegrates, returnable only by wish or similar magic.

name: Bottled Comet
description:
A glass orb holding a hovering, ignited delerium shard crackling with colored energy.
As an action you throw it up to 30 feet; it bursts in a 20-foot radius. Each creature there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 8d6 necrotic and gains a level of contamination, and an arcane anomaly occurs at the point of impact.

name: Chancellor's Crest
description:
While wearing this amulet you can read all writing and speak and understand any language. As an action you can cast detect thoughts, sending, or telepathic bond, each once per dawn, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and your proficiency bonus for its attack bonus and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: Comet Smasher
description: Its head is a massive crackling delerium crystal. Hits with it deal an extra 3d6 necrotic. When you roll a 20 on an attack with it, it unleashes an arcane anomaly; roll twice and choose either result.

name: Crown of Westemär
description:
Attuning requires a 1-hour ceremony with six other characters, each attuned to a different Seal of Drakkenheim.
The crown has 3 charges and regains one every ten years; as an action, expend 1 to cast wish. While you wear it, Minazorond, the tower dragons, and the wall gargoyles obey your spoken commands. Seated on the Throne of Drakkenheim, as an action you can telepathically command one dragon or twelve gargoyles within 100 miles of Castle Drakken and see and hear through one of them (with its special senses) until the start of your next turn, while deaf and blind to your own surroundings.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: Delerium Crystal Focus
description: A refined delerium crystal in a glass orb. While holding it you gain +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, and can use it as a spellcasting focus. Once per day, when you cast a spell of 5th level or lower, you can power it from the crystal without a spell slot, triggering a random arcane anomaly.

name: Delerium-Forged Blade
description:
A glowing meteoric-iron blade infused with delerium dust, a glass-encased sliver set in its hilt.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it, can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and can use it as a spellcasting focus. When you roll a 20 to attack a humanoid with it, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes an extra 3d6 necrotic and gains a level of contamination.

name: Flame Lance
description:
A metal lance with a burning tip, fed by a hose from a tank worn on your back.
You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it. The tank has 5 charges; as an action you expend 1 or more to cast burning hands (save DC 15), at 1st level for 1 charge and one level higher per extra charge. Once per day, pouring in a vial of alchemist's fire restores all charges; otherwise they don't recover.

name: Hardened Delerium-tipped Arrows
description: Ammunition tipped with refined delerium. A creature hit by it takes an extra 3d6 necrotic and makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains a level of contamination. On a hit, the tip crumbles and the ammunition becomes nonmagical.

name: Hazewalker Plate
description: Hermetically sealed plate armor with a visored helmet. While worn with the visor closed, you are immune to disease and the poisoned condition, have advantage on saves against effects that cause contamination, have resistance to necrotic and poison damage, and don't need to breathe.

name: Helm of Patron Saints
description:
While wearing it you see invisible creatures and objects within 60 feet, and gain +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

name: Ignacious, the Sword of Burning Truth
description:
A sacred silver blade trailing embers first kindled in the Temple of Lumen.
You gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with it. As a bonus action you speak its name to wreathe it in radiant flame (bright light 40 feet, dim light 40 more), dealing an extra 4d6 radiant on hits until you douse it as a bonus action or drop or sheathe it.
Sentience. Lawful good, Int 11, Wis 19, Cha 23, hearing and darkvision 120 feet; it speaks, reads, and understands Common, Celestial, and Draconic, communicates telepathically, and knows its wielder's thoughts. When drawn it casts zone of truth (save DC 20) centered on itself, maintaining concentration for you.
Personality. Zealously devoted to the Sacred Flame and indifferent to the Falling Fire schism, it seeks to expose deception, always knows when it hears a lie, and a lie spoken by its wielder immediately triggers a conflict.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

name: Inscrutable Staff
attunement_note: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls, and +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC while held.
It has 20 charges, regaining 2d10 at dawn; when you spend the last, roll a d20: on a 1 it triggers a random arcane anomaly, on a 20 it regains 1d10 charges. As an action you can spend charges to cast, with your DC and ability: haste or slow (3), arcane eye or dimension door (4), arcane hand or wall of force (5), disintegrate (6), reverse gravity (7), or maze (8). Without charges you can cast detect magic, floating disk, mage armor, mending, message, or misty step.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: Lord Commander's Badge
description:
Once per dawn, as an action, you bellow a command audible within 300 feet; up to 12 allies you can see who hear it gain 20 temporary hit points and, while those last, advantage on attack rolls and saves.

As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: Purging Rod
description: Once per day, as an action while holding it, you can cast purge contamination. Afterward roll a d20; on a 1 the rod melts into sludge.

name: Refined Delerium Dust
description: A pouch holding an ounce of purified, charged delerium dust. Consuming the full pouch as an action gives you advantage on spell attack rolls and on saves against spells for 1 minute, and you gain a level of contamination.

name: Saint Vitruvio's Phylactery
attunement_note: by a bard, cleric, druid, or paladin
description:
As an action you can cast bless, death ward, greater restoration, prayer of healing, or revivify from it, each once per dawn, using your spellcasting ability and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

name: Sceptre of Saint Vitruvio
description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; as an action you spend charges to cast, with your save DC: guiding bolt (1), flaming sphere (2), or flame strike (5).
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.

name: Skymetal Shield
description:
Hammered meteoric iron set with a delerium crystal.
When a melee or ranged attack hits you, you can use your reaction to absorb its residual energy (you still take the hit), giving the shield 1 charge (maximum 5; unused charges vanish at dawn). As an action you can release all charges: each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 1d6 force per charge, is flung 10 feet, and is knocked prone.

name: Skymetal Staff
description: A refined meteoric-iron quarterstaff with a liquid delerium core. Once on your turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack using it, the target makes a DC 13 Intelligence save or takes an extra 3d6 psychic, can't take reactions until the start of your next turn, and on its next turn can take only one of an action, a bonus action, or movement.

name: Spellpiercing Wand
description: You can use it as a spellcasting focus. Creatures saving against a spell cast through it can't benefit from advantage on the save.

name: Spymaster's Signet
description:
While wearing it you can cast disguise self at will. Once per dawn, as an action, you and your gear turn invisible for 1 minute or until you become visible as a bonus action.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: Staff of Contaminated Power
attunement_note: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description:
A magic quarterstaff granting +2 to attack and damage rolls.
It has 20 charges, regaining 1 for each hour it rests in the Deep Haze; touching a delerium crystal to it restores 2d8 + 4 as the crystal crumbles. Spending the last charge gives you 1d6 levels of contamination. As an action you can spend charges to cast, with your DC and ability and without gaining contamination: delerium orb (1), warp bolt (2), ride the rifts (3), delerium blast (4), conjure the deep haze (5), or ray of contamination (6).

name: Starcrossed Bow
description:
A bow or crossbow fitted with delerium shards and lenses that conjures its own projectiles.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it; it deals radiant instead of piercing damage and ignores the ammunition and loading properties. It has 3 charges, regained at dawn; when you hit with it, you can spend 1 to make the bolt burst, and the target and each creature within 10 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or are blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Steward's Seal
description:
While wearing this badge you can cast mage hand, prestidigitation, purify food and drink, and unseen servant at will. As an action you can cast animate objects, create food and water, dispel magic, or telekinesis, each once per dawn, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and your proficiency bonus for its attack bonus and save DC.
Seal of Drakkenheim. You can attune to only one Seal. Guardian constructs such as wall gargoyles and tower dragons won't attack you while you are attuned to one, unless you attack or cast a spell on that guardian (which then ignores the seal for 24 hours). As an action you can present the seal to rebuke them: make an opposed Charisma check against each such guardian within 30 feet that can see or hear you; each you beat can't move, act, or react for 1 minute or until damaged, and each that beats you is immune for 24 hours.

name: The Shield of Sacred Flame
description:
It has 3 charges, regained at dawn. When a spellcaster within 60 feet targets you with a spell or includes you in its area, you can spend 1 charge to cast counterspell as a reaction.
Relic of Saint Vitruvio. A character attuned to three Relics of Saint Vitruvio can cast heal three times per long rest and can attune to two extra magic items, provided both are also Relics.
